T0528.title: API Gateway
T0528.definition: An entry layer that centralizes API routing, authentication, rate limiting, logging, and policy enforcement.
T0528.description: An API gateway centralizes authentication, authorization, rate limiting, audit logging, routing, and policy enforcement. It reduces duplicated control logic across services, but incomplete coverage, bypass paths, or incorrect tenant-context propagation can concentrate risk at the entry layer. Reviews should clarify the security boundary between gateway and backend services.
T0528.usageExample: Assess API Gateway related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
